@graph.rdfs:label: võtab üle direktiivi (transposes directive)
@graph.rdfs:comment: Links an Estonian act to the EU directive it transposes.

@graph.rdfs:label: üle võetud (transposed by)
@graph.rdfs:comment: Inverse of transposesDirective — links an EU directive to the national law that transposes it.

@graph.rdfs:label: ülevõtmise staatus (transposition status)
@graph.rdfs:comment: Corpus transposition status of an EU directive: transposed, no_measure_required or no_evidence_in_corpus (#711). Never 'not transposed': no_evidence_in_corpus is a statement about this corpus, not a legal finding.
